name: Airdrie FTO Day One 2027

venue.name: Cairnlea Parish Church Auditorium
venue.details: Enter via the main East door at the end of Johnston Street.

information:
### This is a specialist side events competition that does not include 3x3. We do not recommend this competition to first time competitors.

Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!
